Model Engineering: Familiarity with prompt design, LLM fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT), and evaluation metrics for language models. Cloud Deployment: Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure) and building serverless or containerized deployments. NLP Understanding: Solid grasp of NLP concepts including intent detection, dialogue management, and text classification. Problem-Solving Mindset: Ability to translate business problems into AI-first solutions with a user-centric approach. Curiosity and Drive: Passionate about staying at the forefront of AI and using emerging technologies to build innovative travel experiences. 1-4 Yrs Artificial Intelligence, LLM, Conversational Ai, OpenAI, Python, Database Design, Serverless Architecture, Sentiment Analysis

jobs.description: About Guidesly Guidesly is the first mobile app connecting anglers to our deep network of trusted fishing guides. Guidesly finds guides for every angler and every occasion, saltwater, freshwater, boating, drifting down a river or wading. The Guidesly app allows users to see lakes, rivers, oceans, and bodies of water, but also, all recent fishing and weather reports to find the best fishing spots specifically matched to their preferences. Then, users can start browsing through our network of certified fishing guides and book a customized fishing excursion with their guide. And first and foremost, we are a technology company developing the best consumer and guide products to change the outdoor enthusiast and guiding marketplace forever! Come join Guidesly and set cast on a new adventure! Job Description Job Title Senior React Native Full Stack Developer - Immediate Joining Job Summary Guidesly is looking for a Senior React Native developer to join our mobile team as an individual contributor, building and evolving our consumer and guide apps on iOS and Android. You will take ownership of features from design through release and ship polished, high-performance experiences that anglers and fishing guides rely on every day. We're looking for someone who is comfortable with a fast-moving environment, can learn quickly, and takes pride in apps that feel truly native. Job Details As a Senior Developer, you will help develop the next generation of our apps using tools such as React.js, React Native, TypeScript, Gatsby and Webpack, backed by native iOS (Swift/Objective-C) and Android (Kotlin/Java) code where deeper platform integration is needed. You will work closely with Product, Design and Backend teams on features such as interactive maps of lakes, rivers and oceans, live fishing and weather reports, guide discovery, real-time booking and payments. You should be deeply familiar with React and its ecosystem; prior experience owning a production React Native codebase is a strong plus. Responsibilities Build pixel-perfect, buttery smooth UIs across both mobile platforms. Leverage native APIs for deep integrations with both platforms. Diagnose and fix bugs and performance bottlenecks for performance that feels native. Reach out to the open source community to encourage and help implement mission-critical software fixes-React Native moves fast and often breaks things. Maintain code and write automated tests to ensure the product is of the highest quality Contribute to the architecture and technical decisions of the Guidesly mobile apps, follow and help refine coding standards, and take part in code reviews. Write and maintain custom native modules and bridges in Swift/Objective-C (iOS) and Kotlin/Java (Android), and work with the React Native New Architecture (Fabric, TurboModules, JSI) and the Hermes engine. Build location-aware features using maps and geolocation SDKs (e.g., Mapbox, Google Maps, Apple MapKit), including offline map data, background location and geofencing. Integrate platform services such as push notifications (FCM/APNs), deep and universal links, in-app payments and booking flows (e.g., Stripe, Apple Pay, Google Pay), camera and photo libraries, and secure device storage. Design offline-first experiences with robust caching, data synchronization and graceful handling of poor connectivity, which is common on lakes, rivers and remote waters. Profile and optimize app performance (startup time, memory, battery, frame rate, bundle and binary size) using Flipper, Xcode Instruments, Android Studio Profiler and React DevTools. Take your features through the release process: manage builds, signing, certificates and provisioning, and ship to the App Store and Google Play, including staged rollouts, OTA updates and release monitoring. jobs.title: Sr Associate Data Engineer - Consumer Products AI
jobs.description: About Us Bain Company is a global management consulting firm that helps the worlds most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 65 offices in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition, and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry. In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network), with its nodes across various geographies. BCN is an integral and largest unit of Expert Client Delivery (ECD). ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bains case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutions across all industries and specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence, or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises Consulting Services, Knowledge Services, and Shared Services. About You This role requires strong hands-on experience in SQL, Python, relational data modeling, and data warehousing. The candidate will design and implement data pipelines, data models, and validation workflows, and is expected to scope features and make architecture decisions rather than execute only within a pre-defined scope. The role includes active participation in project planning, stakeholder communication, and quality assurance to support timely delivery of high-impact work. Full-week coverage is required, with overlap into US working hours to support the onshore team. The BCN Senior Associate will work closely with team managers, OPEXEngine Strategy Ops leadership, Bain case teams, and external customers to build and deliver scalable, automated, and commercially relevant data solutions. The working style of the team is centered on scalable product and capability development; therefore, pipelines and data solutions built in this role should be robust, automated, and designed for long-term maintainability. The individual should also be comfortable creating structure in ambiguity. What Youll Do Write and optimize SQL-based queries and transformations to support metric calculations, data checks, and deliverables for Bain case teams and external customers. Operationalize the annual benchmarking cycle: build cohorts from defined selection criteria, calculate benchmarks and quartiles, validate the output, and ensure it is published to the platform. Design and execute data cleaning rules that improve structural validity across the benchmark database. Scope, design, and build platform features that strengthen the data pipeline, such as validation tooling that flags taxonomy breaks and percentile performance views across the database. Make schema and architecture decisions across the ingestion, metric calculation, and benchmarking pipeline, ensuring solutions are scalable, automated, and maintainable. Gather business requirements and process knowledge from Strategy Ops, and translate them into scalable data models, transformations, and outputs aligned to end-user needs. Investigate data issues within the pipeline, identify root causes, communicate implications to stakeholders, and propose effective solutions. Prepare clear technical and process documentation for ongoing maintenance, knowledge transfer, and future reference. Manage communication with onshore teams and stakeholders regarding project progress, data quality, and key insights. Support project planning and resource management, including prioritization, work allocation, and tracking progress across concurrent initiatives. Provide technical guidance and day-to-day support to junior team members, review output for quality, and drive reusable capability building through shared assets, frameworks, and documentation standards. Qualifications and Experience Work Experience: 6+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Management, Business Intelligence, or Business Analytics, with strong hands-on experience in SQL, Python, data warehousing, and relational database design. Education Required: Incumbent should be a graduate/postgraduate from a top-tier institute or have pursued a statistical/analytical course from a Tier 1 university. Preferred: Concentration in a quantitative discipline such as Engineering, Computer Science, Econometrics, Business Analytics, or Market Research is strongly preferred. Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required Advanced SQL knowledge (complex queries, stored procedures, performance tuning, optimization, etc.). Strong hands-on Python for data processing, validation, automation, and scripting. Strong understanding of ETL concepts, data warehousing principles, and relational database architecture, with hands-on experience on SQL Server or a comparable relational database. Working knowledge of cloud technologies, preferably AWS (e.g., EC2, RDS, CloudWatch). Strong understanding of data modeling, schema design, and scalable data pipeline architecture. Ability to independently scope features, design solutions, and make architecture decisions, including where requirements start out ambiguous. Experience with Git-based version control and CI/CD workflows; GitLab experience preferred. Experience coordinating projects, managing resources, and driving execution across multiple stakeholders. Ability to provide technical leadership, coach junior team members, and review output for quality and accuracy. Strong organizational skills, including planning, prioritization, and time management. High attention to detail and commitment to data quality. Passion for solving complex data problems and working with large, diverse data sets. Ability to quickly learn new tools, technologies, and business contexts. Good to have (not mandatory): SaaS domain expertise or PL fluency, and prior experience with benchmarking or survey-based data sets. Good to have (not mandatory): Familiarity with PHP or JavaScript/React for full-stack contribution, and exposure to LLM/API integration. What Makes Us a Great Place to Work We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the worlds best places to work, a champion of diversity, and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the #1 consulting firm on Glassdoors Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoors list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion, and collaboration are key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities, and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor, and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ individuals, and parents.
